feature_definitions.energy_rise: positive first difference of auxiliary log10 power / 12; first point zero
feature_definitions.spectral_flux: positive L1 difference of main spectra normalized to unit magnitude sum
feature_definitions.spectral_change: half the L1 difference of main spectra normalized to unit magnitude sum
feature_definitions.high_frequency: auxiliary Hann spectral power above cutoff / total spectral power
feature_definitions.high_frequency_rise: positive first difference of high_frequency; first point zero
feature_definitions.periodicity: maximum nonnegative overlap-normalized autocorrelation of demeaned main windows
feature_definitions.periodicity_rise: positive first difference of periodicity; first point zero
feature_definitions.activity: clip((relative power dB + 60) / 40, 0, 1) using auxiliary unweighted power; not probability

feature_metadata.periodicity_warning: Auxiliary correlation cue, not pitch tracking, voicing probability or boundary confidence
feature_metadata.latency_warning: Centered windows see future samples and can respond before an onset; no guessed correction is applied

limitations: Source annotation differences are not independently verified human accuracy.
No source alias confirmation or independent test-set claim.
Selection uses validation only; training metrics are diagnostic.
Only the best validation trial is evaluated on test, even when selected remains coarse.
No resampling, waveform shift, calibrated confidence, or model inference.

policy.pooling: mtl:legacy and mtl_bdr:legacy; one configuration for both
